'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***[[2025 Beledweyne hotel attack]]
****[[Somali Armed Forces|Somali security forces]] end the 24-hour siege at a [[hotel]] in [[Beledweyne]], [[Hiran, Somalia|Hiran]], [[Somalia]], with at least fifteen civilians and all six [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] attackers killed. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2gdjd57lro.amp (BBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/somalia-attack-cairo-hotel-beledweyne-shabab-siege-54575e8873eae84990b61f75b4fa2811?utm_source=copy&utm_medium=share (AP)]
****Following the attack, over 100 [[Federal Parliament of Somalia|Somali parliament]] members urge [[President of Somalia|President]] [[Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]] to [[resign]], citing leadership failures amid worsening security and governance crises. [https://www.idilnews.com/over-100-somali-lawmakers-demand-hassan-sheikh-mohamuds-resignation-amid-beledweyne-hotel-attack/ (Idil News)] [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-president-urged-to-resign-over-security-foreign-policy-failures (Garowe Online)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Western Syria clashes (December 2024–present)|Western Syria clashes]]
***[[2025 massacres of Syrian Alawites]], [[March 2025 Western Syria clashes]]
****The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] documents three further reprisal massacres of [[Alawites|Alawite]] minority communities on 12 March in which 158 civilians were killed, totaling 1,383 civilian deaths as a result of fifty separate massacres conducted in western [[Syria]] since March 6. [https://www.barrons.com/news/at-least-1-383-civilians-killed-in-syria-violence-new-monitor-toll-114f3900 (''Barron's'')]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**[[2025 Jaffar Express hijacking|2025 ''Jaffar Express'' hijacking]]
***Security forces rescue all surviving passengers and security personnel from yesterday's hijacking of the ''[[Jaffar Express]]'' [[passenger train]] in [[Pakistan]] by the [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] (BLA). Officials confirm the deaths of all 33 BLA militants, as well as 29 passengers, and 8 soldiers. [https://news24online.com/world/pakistan-train-attack-jaffar-express-rescue-operation-ends-33-terrorists-killed-and-30-civilians-dead/500820/ (News 24)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/12/pakistan-forces-continue-operation-to-free-hundreds-from-hijacked-train (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kursk offensive (2024–present)|Kursk offensive]]
***[[Russian Ground Forces|Russian troops]], backed by [[close air support]], enter the town of [[Sudzha]] in [[Kursk Oblast]], ending seven months of [[Ukrainian occupation of Kursk Oblast|Ukrainian occupation]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/russia-reportedly-enters-ukraine-held-sudzha-in-kursk-oblast-kyiv-hasn-t-confirmed/ar-AA1ALhDd (MSN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-verge-losing-kursk-pocket-its-foothold-inside-russia-2025-03-12/ (Reuters)]
***[[Chief of the General Staff (Russia)|Chief of the Russian General Staff]] [[Valery Gerasimov]] says that remaining Ukrainian forces in Kursk Oblast are [[Encirclement|entirely surrounded]]. [https://en.protothema.gr/2025/03/12/putin-visits-kursk-in-camouflage-uniform-a-day-after-u-s-kyiv-ceasefire-deal-ukrainian-forces-encircled/ (''Proto Thema'')]{{unreliable inline}}

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]], [[Canada–United States relations]]
**[[Canada|Canadian]] [[Minister of Finance (Canada)|finance minister]] [[Dominic LeBlanc]] announces retaliatory [[tariffs]] on [[CAD$]]29.8 billion ([[US$]]20.7 billion) of goods from the [[United States]] after [[United States President|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announced additional tariffs on Canadian [[metalworking|metals]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/canada-announces-tariffs-on-207-billion-of-us-goods/a-71896104 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict]]
**[[Angola]] confirms that peace talks between the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] (DRC) and the [[Rwanda]]n-backed [[March 23 Movement]] will begin on 18 March, after the DRC previously insisted on solely negotiating with Rwanda. [https://www.dw.com/en/dr-congo-m23-rebels-to-hold-peace-talks-in-angola/a-71904502 (DW)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[Supreme Leader of Iran|Iranian supreme leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]] rejects negotiations with the U.S. regarding [[nuclear program of Iran|Iran's nuclear program]], stating that Iran is "not interested in [[nuclear weapons]]". [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5y02jexjxxo (BBC News)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**The [[Houthi]] movement in [[Yemen]] announces it will resume targeting [[Israel]]i ships because its deadline for Israel to resume aid deliveries to the [[Gaza Strip]] has passed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/12/yemens-houthis-to-resume-shipping-attacks-over-gaza-aid-cutoff (''Al Jazeera'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*The City Court in [[Tbilisi]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], convicts former [[President of Georgia|president]] [[Mikheil Saakashvili]] of [[embezzlement]] and sentences him to nine years in prison. The court also fines the former head of the [[Special State Protection Service of Georgia|Special State Protection Service]], [[Teimuraz Janashia]], [[Georgian lari|₾]]300,000 ({{Euro}}99,936) in connection to the case. [https://www.dw.com/en/georgia-ex-president-saakashvili-jailed-for-9-more-years/a-71896528 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Belizean general election]]
**[[Belizeans]] vote to elect the 31 members of the [[House of Representatives (Belize)|House of Representatives]] between the incumbent [[People's United Party]] and the opposition [[United Democratic Party (Belize)|United Democratic Party]]. The ruling party is re-elected by 26 seats to 5. [https://www.breakingbelizenews.com/2025/03/12/breaking-peoples-united-party-claim-another-wide-victory-in-2025-general-elections/ (Breaking Belize News)] [https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2025/03/13/belizes-ruling-party-wins-general-election/ (''Jamaica Observer'')]
*The [[President of Syria|Syrian presidential office]] announces the creation of the [[National Security Council (Syria)|National Security Council]] as a means of confronting national and internal security problems. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrias-interim-president-sharaa-forms-national-security-council-2025-03-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Swiss Federal Council election]]
**Following the resignation of [[Switzerland|Swiss]] [[Federal Department of Defence, Civil Protection and Sport|Defense Minister]] [[Viola Amherd]], the [[Federal Assembly (Switzerland)|Federal Assembly]] votes to elect the new member of the [[Federal Council (Switzerland)|Federal Council]]. [[Martin Pfister]] is elected as the head of the defense ministry. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/martin-pfister-elected-new-swiss-federal-council-member-2025-03-12/ (Reuters)] [https://www.srf.ch/news/schweiz/martin-pfister-gewinnt-das-war-die-bundesratswahl (Radio SRF)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024–25 FIS Ski Jumping World Cup]]
**Norwegian [[ski jumpers]] [[Marius Lindvik]] and [[Johann André Forfang]] are suspended by [[International Ski and Snowboard Federation|FIS]] and will not participate in [[Raw Air]] due to an ongoing investigation involving the manipulation of ski equipment. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/ski-jumping-norwegian-ski-jumpers-suspended-amid-equipment-investigation-2025-03-12/ (Reuters)]
